rulings.reason: The gradient is dominated by whether the record contains an abstract body at all (0 = missing or a title-only stub), which is a data-completeness and judge-contamination check on the corpus rather than evidence about the research; the cited R20 case shows exactly this, since a truncated record says nothing about the paper's quality. Missing or stub abstracts arise from collection artifacts that do not themselves produce better or worse research, so no undiscounted readout is warranted.
